name: Delhi
summary: India's capital: Mughal monuments, Old Delhi bazaars, grand colonial avenues and the gateway to Agra and Jaipur.
season_note: October to March is pleasant; winter mornings have fog and smog. April to June is extremely hot; July-September is monsoon.
avoid_note: Winter (Nov-Jan) air pollution can be severe; check the AQI.
entry_note: Indian visa is required for Bangladeshi passport holders (apply via the Indian Visa Application Centre; category as currently offered). Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Indira Gandhi International Airport (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India; often via Kolkata)
Dhaka to Kolkata (Maitree) then Kolkata-Delhi Rajdhani

local.note: Clean and cheap; best for most trips.

attractions.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
attractions.what: A UNESCO Mughal fort with museums and a light-and-sound show.
attractions.tip: Closed on Mondays; bring ID for foreigner entry.

attractions.name: Jama Masjid
attractions.what: One of India's largest mosques; climb the minaret for views.
attractions.tip: Dress modestly; entry timings around prayer.

attractions.name: Humayun's Tomb
attractions.what: A UNESCO garden-tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal.

attractions.name: Qutub Minar
attractions.what: A 73m red-sandstone victory tower from the 12th century.

attractions.name: India Gate and Kartavya Path
attractions.what: War memorial and lawns, lit at night.

attractions.name: Chandni Chowk Bazaar
attractions.what: Narrow lanes with sweets, spices, paratha and fabrics.
attractions.tip: Cycle rickshaw ride is fun; watch for pickpockets.

attractions.name: Lotus Temple
attractions.what: A lotus-shaped Bahai house of worship.

attractions.name: Akshardham Temple
attractions.what: A huge modern temple complex with exhibits and fountain show.
attractions.tip: No phones or bags allowed inside; strict security.

rules: Use official taxis or apps; avoid touts at airport/station.
Photography is restricted at some monuments (check signs).
